requirements.text: The app must provide a modern and fast user experience similar to fintech competitors like Revolut.
The app must send real-time push notifications for transactions and budget limits.
The app must include budgeting tools that allow users to set category limits and receive alerts.
The app must provide a monthly breakdown of spending with clear categories such as food, transport, and entertainment.
The app must have a modern and clean user interface that is easy to navigate.
The app should retain any existing elements that work well, while allowing for a complete redesign.
